review.notes: Removed the separate 'limitation' entry, which duplicated the other_procedural complaint using the identical quote. The petitioner's single complaint is that repeated s.65 audit memos, issued beyond the s.65(4) audit time limit, taint the derivative SCN -- that is a s.65 audit-timeline argument, not 'notice or order issued after the time limit' under s.73/74 (contracts.md's definition of limitation), so other_procedural fits better and one entry suffices. Note the court actually agreed the repeated-audit-memo practice was irregular (para 7-9) but held that is 'not a valid ground' to invalidate the SCN (para 10) -- per the finding rules that is still defect_rejected even though the underlying irregularity was accepted as fact. No order has issued yet (pre-adjudication SCN challenge), so order fields are correctly all null.
